project_type: React SPA with Konva canvas (Vite + TypeScript)
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vite build
test_command: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run
verification_instructions: 1. Run typecheck to ensure no new TS errors. 2. Run vitest to ensure all 1094+ tests pass. 3. Run vite build to ensure production build succeeds.
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && npm install (already done, node_modules present)
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network. Must use 'unset NODE_OPTIONS' before npx commands due to proxy-bootstrap issue. Node v22.23.2.
contribution_requirements: Visual-only changes. Do NOT modify business logic, engines, or stores. Push to feat/db-baseline-v1.1.5 AND main.
key_patterns: CSS custom properties in src/styles/design-system.css. Layout grid in src/styles/layout.css. Components use inline styles currently. Canvas uses react-konva layers with Konva primitives (Rect, Line, etc). Stores are Zustand. Routing in main.tsx with react-router-dom v7. AppShell wraps only /canvas route currently (needs fixing). All authenticated routes under <ProtectedRoute /> in main.tsx.
directory_structure: frontend/src/styles/ - CSS files. frontend/src/components/Layout/ - shell components. frontend/src/canvas/layers/ - Konva canvas layers. frontend/src/components/ - UI panels and toolbar. frontend/src/stores/ - Zustand state. frontend/src/pages/ - route pages. frontend/src/main.tsx - routing.
